sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling by junior member combined with extreme market fear (35 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, though lack of news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (350.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings binary event in 9 days compounding volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI14, supertrend, and hull are bullish with price near support (249.40), and extreme fear (VIX crisis) presents contrarian opportunity for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trades below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), ADX is weak (22.99), earnings binary event in 9 days, macro environment severely unfavourable (VIX 350.6, rising dollar, recession signals), and zero fundamental conviction from insiders or institutions.
